validation_gaps: DeepSeek-V4.1 checkpoint, DSpark drafter, stochastic coupling, stateful prefix-hit and session replay require model-level acceptance. #1376 skips model layers during prefill and cannot be admitted on speed evidence alone. #1373 persistent PP batches are kept out of the generic bugfix candidate pending PP2+speculation/session qualification. Generic step-ownership fix #1371 is tested separately.
closure_authorization: Owner requested qualified merges and consolidation of related unqualified work into a few drafts, retaining all source and records before closing superseded entries.
source_retention: Publication commit parents/ancestors retain every exact original head and full source tree; original branches are not deleted. Patches and complete discussion snapshots are also retained here.
